title: Interpretable SWI radiomics model predicts tertiary lymphoid structures in hepatocellular carcinoma
summary: In 477 retrospectively enrolled patients (290 training, 125 validation, 62 independent validation), a random forest was the best of five machine-learning classifiers on susceptibility-weighted MRI radiomics, with an independent-cohort AUC of 0.771 (95% CI 0.641-0.883), sensitivity 78.6% and specificity 67.6%. SHAP explained the model, and the predicted iTLS+ group had improved time to recurrence. The AUC is modest and centre or time independence and blinding were not confirmed.
ai_technology: Radiomics with random forest, SVM, XGBoost, logistic regression and KNN, with SHAP interpretation

evidence.tested: Internal validation (n=125) and independent validation (n=62) against a pathology reference.
evidence.unknown: Centre and time independence of the validation cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning classifiers predicted iTLS from MRI radiomics.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
